task.title: Go live
task.description:
## Why
A final check that nothing needed for a public launch was skipped.

## Steps
1. Confirm Sleeper's answer on terms allows the launch as planned.
2. Run reports for one league of each fixture type on production and compare them with the CLI.
3. Confirm the alerts reach someone, and that the daily player and values jobs ran last night.
4. Confirm the privacy and credits pages are live.
5. Announce the site.

## Done when
- Every item above is checked off in a comment on this task.
